name: spooler-ui
description: Spooler pages (Vue 3 + PrimeVue 4, shared Orca UI foundation), built into one offline HTML file embedded in plugin/spooler/spooler_any.py

scripts.build: node shared/scripts/check.mjs && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/emit.mjs && python3 ../scripts/embed_ui.py
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:page
